title:
No Black Box.
No Secrets.
Just Brilliant Code.
subtitle: The Agentic Layer is Open Source.
description: We believe the future of Enterprise AI is based on openness. Our Agentic Layer is therefore open source. This eliminates vendor lock-in and creates maximum transparency, operational security, and architectural flexibility. Look under the hood yourself, adapt the code to your needs, or get involved in our growing community.
